- Retrieval scores and panel ranks are not available. Reason from the experimental records and the chemistry or biology that can be supported from the visible context.

The most direct analogue record reports restricted brain exposure after systemic administration, so it is the strongest experimental anchor. Several other records independently support the same direction under relevant conditions.
